parsing_context.name: pseudo_header_info
parsing_context.description: The concept prefixing the UDP header, containing source address, destination address, protocol (17), and UDP length (derived from 'length' field).

helper_functions.name: calculate_checksum
helper_functions.description: Calculates the 16-bit one's complement of the one's complement sum of the pseudo header, the UDP header, and the data, padded with zero octets at the end if necessary.
